description.p: Recompilations and decompilations are native PC versions of console games, rebuilt by their developers from the original game. RecompLauncher finds, installs, updates and starts them, straight from each developer's own GitHub release.

ul.li: Discover every project, with what it needs and how it runs for other players
Install and update in one click, with every download checked against GitHub's checksum
Easy Setup: point it at your disc image or game folder and it does the rest
Save backups before every update, and optional cloud saves
Big Picture mode for a controller and a TV

description.p: No game files are included: every game needs your own copy, which you choose the first time you set it up.

description.p: Home follows the order set on the website with info boxes in your language, new consoles, one Save button for Coming Soon games, a Set Up by You pill and an Easy Setup switch for new games, safer cloud saves, clearer setup failures, and many fixes.

Easy Setup rebuilt so every game sets up the same way, games build again with every new release and after a build that was cut short, every build shows on Downloads with its progress, cloud saves are asked about once, and cleaner game pages.
A new update window with a changelog, cleaner game page stats, Launcher Support says where each feature comes from, starting with your PC, and fixes for a blank window and Mac games.

Rebuilt Updates, Saves, Shaders and Manage tabs, cloud save status above Play, updating every game automatically from Settings, Play finishes an update that needs a new build, games can say what they need from your PC, and Discover is now Catalog.
Reworks how games install, update and build, Easy Setup keeps your choices, updates go in whole or not at all, cloud save status for each game, and the featured banner can be turned off.

Easy Setup goes in clear steps on the desktop and in Big Picture, setup options a game needs are marked Required, the game page is cleaner, consoles are listed A to Z, custom logos show full size in Big Picture, and using a build you already made works for more games.
Fixes games built from your copy asking to set up again after an update.
The Verified label on a download opens its scan report.
Games that install with their own setup no longer show as missing before Set Up, and the Library can sort by game name.
The window opens on the right screen at a size that fits, updates show for games whose project moved, Linux .NET games find .NET, and the launcher starts faster.
Easy Setup can be switched on and off from a game's Manage tab, and a game's page shows its latest version before you install it.
Playtime by game across recomps, kept through reinstalls and synced with your account, and each game of a multi-game release gets its own place in the store.
Linux .NET games start through their own start script, controller A waits for the D-pad on the desktop, and setups that build inside the game's folder are recognized.
Games built from your copy are built again when their setup changes or their build is missing, and Steam names itself when it asks to share the screen.
Saves restore into the folder a game uses now, Switch copies are recognized by their title ID, and setups run more reliably in the Flatpak.
Updates can be paused for one game, a copy a game no longer needs can go to the trash, builds kept in a folder of their own can move to another drive, and Big Picture asks where new games go.
Easy Setup can be skipped for one game from its menu, or for every game in Settings, and games built from your copy can use a build you already have, wherever it is.
Easy Setup shows each game's own cartridge, card or disc with its art, with discs that spin and cartridges that click into place, and optional console labels across the top of covers.

Updates keep the setup and lost setups can be relinked, builds made with a developer's own launcher are picked up, ratings for the latest version, cleaner game cards, reasons for recommended versions, a choice of install folder, sign-in for reports, and a single Verified label for checked releases.

Xbox 360 achievements found in more places and after a game closes, a way to show the Achievements tab a game's save folder, Discord status only while the launcher is in use, ROM scans for zipped ROMs, arcade sets and Wii U archives, and installed games found next to similarly named sequels.

Fixes games asking to be set up again after updating the launcher, finds disc sets kept as .cue, .gdi and .m3u, and fixes setup opening after a game update and the Discord status while the launcher waits in the tray.

Setups that keep going in the background and stop cleanly when cancelled, game file scans for Xbox 360 updates and DLC and PS3 packages, a quit option and Scan pill in Big Picture mode, and fixes for small windows, update checks, picked programs, Easy Setup and covers on Linux.

A weekly Trending row on Discover, developer names on game pages, a start window with the logo, scroll bars in Big Picture mode, an Auto-Install setting, Arch Linux packages, and fixes for updates, picked programs and handheld animations.

Bring your games over from another launcher in one go, browse Discover by game, switch to a better version in one step, setup options such as DLSS and FSR 4, plain copies of compressed game images, and fixes for builds, Python games and saves.
Pick the monitor Big Picture opens on, a 12- or 24-hour clock, one Steam collection for every game the launcher adds, See All on every shelf, and fixes for controllers, saves and installs.
Add a Recomp and Request a Recomp take a link to any project, including Forgejo and Gitea servers, whose recomps show their README and get Easy Setup from their own setup file.
Recomps from Forgejo servers, a Library that keeps every game, prod.keys accepted, self-updates on Linux, and fixes for covers, search and setup.
Bring Your Games for moving over from another launcher, self-updates on a Mac, and Big Picture fixes.
A Coming Soon page with recomp requests, Keep Steam in Sync, Sync Now for cloud saves, shared game media across versions, and a smoother Downloads graph.
A window that opens once drawn, a clearer tray icon, smoother Big Picture on Steam Deck, and crash reports on GitHub.
No more false Offline mark, smarter cloud save uploads, and fixes.
Save sharing between versions of a game, a Run in background setting, drag to reorder pinned games, cleaner game and Achievements pages, and fixes.
NVIDIA DLSS for recomps that ask for it, saved games that sync between PCs, proxy support, and fixes.
Recomp Achievements fixes and improvements.
New versions show up when RecompLauncher opens, smoother updates and more accurate play time.
Safer launcher updates, plus improvements and fixes.
A redesigned Downloads page, plus improvements and fixes.
